resources.string: Keep Swiggy closed while Beta builds and checks your cart. Stay in Beta until the check finishes.
Opening Swiggy can reload a different cart or address. Check both before paying. Adding to cart does not place an order.
You left Beta, so the unconfirmed plan was paused. Your list is saved. Keep Swiggy closed and continue to check the products and address again.
You are back in Beta. We are checking the latest cart and delivery address without adding anything.
The latest cart and address match the reviewed changes. This check has not added anything or placed an order.

Beta cannot confirm that your cart and address still match the earlier review. The review may have expired, or the cart or address may have changed. Please check them again. Beta will not add anything again automatically.
Beta cannot confirm your last cart update now. Please review both the items and delivery address in Swiggy. Nothing will be added again automatically.
Hi. Let\'s make grocery ordering easier.
Beta builds your Swiggy cart and helps you review checkout before you pay.
Adding groceries builds your cart. You stay in control of ordering and payment. When checkout in Beta is enabled, placing an order needs a separate final confirmation.
I heard you. Getting that ready…
Voice recognition is not available on this phone. You can type your list instead.
The microphone is busy. Please wait a moment and try again.
Voice recognition needs a connection. You can type your list instead.
I did not hear a grocery list. Please try again or type it.
Allow the microphone so you can speak your grocery list. It is used only while you speak.
Allow the microphone so you can speak your grocery list instead of typing. It is used only while you speak.
For example: atta, milk and two bananas
Speak or type. You can switch between them anytime.
Please speak or type what you need.
Swiggy opens in a secure browser for your phone number and OTP. Beta never sees your OTP. Connecting does not place an order or start payment.
Speak or type your grocery list. Beta shows the exact cart changes and asks before adding anything.
Your secure Swiggy connection has expired. Reconnect to continue.
Address cleared. Beta will ask you to choose an address for your next Swiggy cart.
Use this phone\'s location to move a nearby saved Swiggy address to the top. Your location stays on the phone and is never sent to Beta. You still choose and confirm the address.
Swiggy will open in your browser. Enter your phone number and OTP there.
Beta received an invalid Swiggy sign-in link. Please try again later.
Swiggy could not be connected. Please try again.
Swiggy needs you to sign in again
Beta can no longer use your Swiggy sign-in. Sign in again in your browser to keep using Beta. This does not place an order or change your cart.
Finish signing in on Swiggy\'s page
Swiggy\'s sign-in page opened in your browser. Enter your phone number and OTP there. Beta never sees your OTP. When you finish, Swiggy brings you back here.
Your internet may be slow, or Swiggy did not answer. Nothing was changed. Tap Try again to check once more.
Couldn\'t open Swiggy sign-in just now
Your grocery list and delivery address (%1$s) are kept. Nothing in Swiggy is changed.
Your delivery address (%1$s) is kept. Nothing in Swiggy is changed.
Swiggy is connected again. Your saved list is below. Tap Continue when you\'re ready.
open Swiggy sign-in in your browser
Open a local Swiggy demo that shows request, address, cart, and payment review steps without changing anything.
DEMO ONLY — no real order or payment
This is a practice run. Your cart, saved addresses and grocery list stay unchanged. Nothing will be ordered or charged.
Swiggy is finishing the confirmed cart update. Wait for the cart check before changing apps.
Connect securely in your browser. No screen access is needed.
Swiggy is connected. Speak or type your grocery list below.
This opens Swiggy\'s secure sign-in page. After you enter your phone number and OTP, Beta can use your saved addresses and recent Instamart choices.
Beta will remove its secure Swiggy connection. You can reconnect anytime.
You confirmed this address earlier in this session. Beta shows only the saved address name and asks again after 15 minutes.
Beta searches a few products at a time. Results stay in the order you said them.
Your Swiggy cart starts empty. Review every requested line before Beta updates it once.
Your existing cart stays. Review only the requested quantity changes before Beta updates it once.
Added by Swiggy, not by Beta
Beta read the cart back and verified every requested line.
This step updates your cart before checkout review. It does not place an order or approve payment.

Beta can share usage and crash information linked to this copy of the app, such as how often carts are built, to improve reliability. No grocery items, addresses, names, GPS coordinates, OTPs, or Swiggy details are ever included. You can change this anytime in Settings.
Your answer helps us make grocery lists more reliable.
Could not open %1$s. Please open it manually and try again.
Beta and Swiggy match your list. No AI provider receives it.

Beta’s servers will send %1$s everything you type or say, as text. They may send it again with our draft so %1$s can check it. %1$s also receives matching shop listings: item wording, dietary and other needs, pack size and price. We don’t remove anything you type. Leave out names, addresses or health details you don’t want shared. We don’t attach your voice recording, location, saved addresses, payment details or past orders. This choice is saved on this phone. You can turn it off at any time, and standard matching keeps working.
OpenAI is off. New lists won’t be sent.
Your earlier Gemini limited preview is still on. You can keep it, or choose another option.
Your earlier choice can’t be used.
Use standard matching for new lists?
Internal test build. Not for public phones.
A consent screen appears before this provider can receive a list.
%1$s is off. New lists won’t be sent.
Switch to %1$s? %2$s won’t receive new lists. %1$s needs your permission first.
